text: The authors state that Irving et al.'s original debate framework assumed the honest strategy can simulate deterministic AI systems for an exponential number of steps, which limits its applicability. They design new debate protocols in which the honest strategy succeeds with a polynomial number of simulation steps and can verify stochastic AI systems, even when the dishonest strategy uses exponentially many steps.
title: Brown-Cohen et al. extend Irving et al.'s debate to stochastic AI systems with poly-step simulation
